units.source_text: ”就把车子驱向对面山麓的草原上，

en.t: they drove the carriage to the meadow at the foot of the opposite mountain,

units.source_text: 勿令他人走近，仅由知道实情的几个僧人举办火葬。

en.t: kept everyone else from coming near, and had only the few monks who knew the truth conduct the cremation.

units.source_text: 这火葬很简单，烟气一会儿就消失了。

en.t: The cremation was very simple, and the smoke soon vanished.

units.source_text: 乡村人对于殡葬仪式，反而比城市人看重，迷信也更深，

en.t: Country people, more than city people, placed great importance on funeral rites and were also more deeply superstitious,

units.source_text: 就有人讥评：“这葬式真奇怪！

en.t: so some criticized it, saying, 'What a strange funeral this is!

units.source_text: 规定的礼节和应有的事项都不完备，

en.t: The prescribed ceremonies and all the proper arrangements are incomplete,

units.source_text: 竟像身份卑贱人家的做法，草率了事。”

en.t: as if it were the practice of some lowly household, rushed through carelessly.'

units.source_text: 又有一人说道：“京都的人，

en.t: Another person said, 'People in the capital,

units.source_text: 凡有兄弟的人家，

en.t: whenever there are brothers in the family,

units.source_text: 故意做得简单。”

en.t: deliberately keep such things simple.'

units.source_text: 此外还有种种令人不安的讥评。

en.t: There were many other troubling criticisms as well.

units.source_text: 右近想道：“这种乡村人的讥评，已足令人警惕，

en.t: Ukon thought, 'Even these criticisms from country people are enough to put one on guard,

units.source_text: 何况消息不能隐瞒，不久就会传开去。

en.t: and besides, the news cannot be hidden; before long it will spread.

units.source_text: 将来薰大将闻知小姐没有遗骸，

en.t: When General Kaoru later hears that the young lady left no remains,

units.source_text: 定会疑心匂亲王将人藏匿。

en.t: he will surely suspect that Prince Niou has hidden her away.

units.source_text: 匂亲王也会疑心薰大将藏匿。

en.t: Prince Niou, too, will suspect that General Kaoru has hidden her.

units.source_text: 但他与大将交往亲密，虽然暂时疑心他，

en.t: But since he is on close terms with the general, even if he suspects him for a while,

units.source_text: 不久终会知道小姐究竟是否在他那里。

en.t: he will soon find out whether the young lady is really with him or not.

units.source_text: 而大将也定然不会一直疑心亲王藏匿。

en.t: And the general surely will not go on forever suspecting that the prince has hidden her.

units.source_text: 于是两人会猜想另有一人把小姐带走隐藏。

en.t: Then both of them will imagine that someone else has taken the young lady away and concealed her.

units.source_text: 小姐生前命好，备受高贵之人怜爱。

en.t: While she lived, the young lady was fortunate and was dearly loved by noble people.

units.source_text: 死后如果被疑心跟下贱人逃走，

en.t: If after death she is suspected of having run away with some lowborn man,

units.source_text: 实在太冤屈了。”

en.t: it would be terribly unjust to her.'

units.source_text: 她很担心，

en.t: She was deeply worried,

units.source_text: 于是仔细察看山庄中所有的仆役，

en.t: so she carefully examined all the servants in the mountain villa,

units.source_text: 凡是在今天的混乱中偶然看破实情的人，

en.t: and as for anyone who had happened to see through the truth amid the day's confusion,

units.source_text: 她都郑重叮嘱其不可泄露。

en.t: she earnestly warned them not to reveal it.
